title: Help for Graduates to Find Employment amidst Tightening Labour Market
what_it_is: Help for Graduates to Find Employment amidst Tightening Labour Market

sections.label: Government and autonomous universities collaboration
sections.summary: The Government works with autonomous universities to align graduate supply with industry demand and industry-relevant skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The Government works closely with the autonomous universities (AUs) to ensure that the supply of graduates takes into account industry demand and that graduates are equipped with industry-relevant skills.

sections.label: Internships and workplace learning centre
sections.summary: Internships connect classroom learning to workplaces and give companies talent aligned to industry needs, with NACE helping employers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The internships allow students to connect what they learn in the classroom with the workplace and allow companies to access a pipeline of talent better aligned to industry needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: There is also the National Centre of Excellence for Workplace Learning (NACE) which helps employers build workplace learning capabilities and raise the quality of internships that they provide to students.

sections.label: NTUC and SNEF Career Starter Lab
sections.summary: NTUC's Youth Taskforce identified quality internships and career mentorships, so NTUC and SNEF piloted the Career Starter Lab in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: NTUC's Youth Taskforce identified that some of the top resources to help youths work towards their desired future jobs were quality internships and career mentorships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Therefore, NTUC and SNEF piloted the Career Starter Lab in 2023, to facilitate career trials, structured workplace attachments and mentorships for youths.

sections.label: Graduate employment survey results
sections.summary: The Joint Autonomous Universities Graduate Employment Survey shows a slight decrease in employment rates but still higher than pre-COVID 2019, with increased starting salaries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: While the recent results from the Joint Autonomous Universities Graduate Employment Survey show a slight decrease in employment rates for graduates, it still remains higher than the pre-COVID levels in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Furthermore, graduates also saw an increase in starting salaries compared to the year before.

sections.label: A*STAR T-UP programme support
sections.summary: Through A*STAR's T-UP programme, the Government works with deep tech startups and incubators, seconding data scientists to help move up the value chain.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: What we have done is, through the Agency for Science, Technology and Research's Technology for Enterprise Capability Upgrading (T-UP) programme, we are working with many of the deep tech startups, the startup incubators, and we second data scientists to help them in moving up the value chain in terms of some of the specialised skill sets that they may require.

sections.label: Careers health and CareersFinder data analytics
sections.summary: Careers health and CareersFinder use data analytics to assess CVs and training, encourage upgrading, and enable better job matching.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Indeed, for careers health and also CareersFinder, which were hallmark initiatives that I had announced at last year's Committee of Supply, we do use a fair bit of data analytics, first to suss out the CVs, the training of our graduates and then, for them to continue to upgrade their own career health by taking an active interest in making sure that their training, the skills adjacencies are up to mark, and also to nudge them and encourage them to upgrade their training, along the entire pathway of their career, so that it allows for better job matching.
